definition: Coincidental means happening together by chance rather than through any connection or plan.
task: Write one sentence of your own using the word coincidental. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know coincidental should be able to work it out from your sentence.
avoid_verbatim: The fire drill landing in the middle of the surprise inspection was entirely coincidental — the two schedules were drawn up months apart by offices that never speak.

Accidental describes a single mishap nobody intended — an elbow catches a glass, a wrong file gets deleted. One thing goes wrong by mistake. Coincidental needs two separate things, each fine on its own, lining up by pure chance; nothing has to go wrong at all.

A chance event is one that luck produced — a chance meeting, a chance discovery — and the word carries no argument with it. Coincidental works harder: it insists that two things landed together and then denies any plan or connection behind the pairing.
